messages.subject: problem with saving the PDF
parts:
Hello:

I have a graph produced by ggplot2 with geom_ribbon, geom_points,
geom_lines. For geom_points, I use shape =1 , size =2, which is a
open circle. The graph is fairly busy and looks fine in R. But, when I
output it to pdf file, the points only shows about 1/4 of the circle.
I tried to increase the size=4, it shows about 3/4 of the circle, the
circle just gets kind of big, which makes the graph even more busy. Is
there any solution to this issue?

Thanks
